items.title: Epic wants to pay you $50,000 to vibe code an AI slop game
items.excerpt: Epic Games' Unreal Engine AI MegaJam promises up to $50,000 in prizes for games built with AI tools ('Vibe your way to 50K'), drawing backlash over Epic's AI-first push.

items.title: "Someone's getting fired": Arc Raiders player says Embark used ChatGPT to respond to their complaint and accidentally sent several messages intended for others
items.excerpt: An Arc Raiders player says Embark Studios support used ChatGPT to answer their complaint, accidentally pasting a chain of about 10 prompt-and-response exchanges including messages meant for other players.

items.title: "Elon Musk disagrees with me. This means I am onto something": Legendary game artist calls out AI billionaires, Tim Sweeney responds "this is bulls***" with Musk's support
items.excerpt: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney backs an AI-first push across the company

items.title: Machinarium AI tribute cops a flogging from studio: 'This looks disgusting'
items.excerpt: Amanita Design condemned an AI-generated 'tribute' to Machinarium posted by the CEO of AI storytelling company Nura Studios, saying it 'looks disgusting and has nothing to do with us or our craft'.

items.title: The developer of an AI-powered driving instruction simulator is spending $1,000 per day just to keep its demo running

items.title: Google's golden age of AI games?
items.excerpt: PC Gamer's Tyler Wilde picks apart a Google article claiming 'AI is unlocking a new golden age of games', questioning what generative AI actually offers players and developers.

items.title: Epic Games' 'Unreal Engine AI MegaJam' contest will reward cash for AI vibe-coded slop games that no one asked for
items.excerpt: Epic Games is running a contest for some people to use AI to make games. Seriously. And they're really excited about it.

items.title: Someone hacked the Switch 2 by using an old game and AI
items.excerpt: The Nintendo Switch 2 has apparently been jailbroken by a modder who used OpenAI tools and the $25 SmileBASIC 4 eShop app, already showing a custom Mario Kart World with new playable characters.

items.excerpt: "Not being able to develop our games in the open has been a real blow, and it's very dispiriting"

items.title: All My Hobbies Are Getting Slopped Up, And It’s Exhausting
items.excerpt: The explosion in vibe coding has created an endless sea of drive-by, unserious, and unmaintained software that is destabilizing longstanding communities.

items.excerpt: Ninjutsu Entertainment posted a video asking SonicFox to reconsider their decision

items.excerpt: A union representing gaming and anime voice actors has issued guidance on the issue after many high-profile voice actors spoke out against generative AI

items.title: Of Course Pokémon's Been Pulled Into The AI Decompilation Frenzy
items.excerpt: Developers used new generative AI models to quickly decompile several Pokémon games, including Brilliant Diamond, Shining Pearl, Snap and HeartGold/SoulSilver, into playable PC ports and mashups that critics call buggy and low quality.

items.title: "I want room to make a wrong turn": Following Samson dev's bankruptcy, its founder is considering how AI might factor into new studio plans
items.excerpt: Liquid Swords founder Christofer Sundberg has discussed how he might approach setting up a new studio following the Samson studio's bankruptcy.

items.title: Dwarf Fortress creator Tarn Adams is as tired of genAI in the industry as anyone else, and is pretty set on never using it
items.excerpt: Tarn Adams, developer of Dwarf Fortress, has some strong feelings on genAI and feels very little could make him budge on that.

items.title: Digital Sun delays ReVamp playtest over AI cloning concerns
items.excerpt: Digital Sun is narrowing its early testing of ReVamp to its Discord community following fears of generative AI-enabled cloning.

items.title: 컴투스플랫폼, GGDC 2026서 '하이브 액실' 소개했다
items.excerpt: 컴투스플랫폼 최석원 대표가 GGDC 2026 연사 및 패널로 참여해 AI 기반 게임 개발의 미래를 조명했다. 최 대표는 강연에서 AI 특화 백엔드 플랫폼 하이브 액실이 글로벌 서비스 운영의 효율적인 대안이라고 강조했다. 또한 업계 전문가들과 함께 패널 토론에 참석해 K게임 생태계...

items.title: AI 역설계 통한 게임 베끼기 극성, 개발 생태계가 무너진다
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI 기술의 발전으로 독창적인 인디게임을 무단 도용하는 복제작이 급증하고 있다. 고도화된 AI 역설계를 악용한 카피캣 범죄로 인해 인디게임 개발자들의 생계가 위협받고 있다. 플랫폼의 소극적인 대처와 미비한 법적 제도 속에서 창작자들의 피해가 심화되는 중이다

items.title: [기획] 격변의 '모딩' 생태계, 울타리 넓히는 게임 산업
items.excerpt: AI 기술 발전으로 게임 모드 시장이 팽창하면서 모드린스는 AI 모드 등록을 제한했고, 넥서스 모드는 AI 활용도에 따른 태그 분류를 도입했다. 게임사들도 대응을 고심 중이다. 라이엇 게임즈는 10월 6일부터 외부 프로그램 접근을 차단했고, 블리자드는 월드 오브 워크래프트 애드온 기능을 제한했다. 반면 스타필드와 발더스 게이트3 등은 공식 모딩 도구를 도입했으며, 2025년 호그와트 레거시, 2026년 스토커2와 심즈4도 지원을 확대한다. Microsoft는 아샤 샤르마 CEO가 언급한 엑스박스 랩스를 통해 게임 재구성을 탐색 중이다. 이제 게임은 잘 만드는 것을 넘어 이용자가 쉽게 바꿀 수 있게 만드는 경쟁력이 중요해졌다.

items.title: Wonder Interactive's Strata uses AI to take Unreal Engine games to browsers using WebAssembly and WebGPU
items.excerpt: Wonder Interactive has unveiled Strata, an AI-powered dev tool that that can turn Unreal Engine projects into playable browser links using WebAssembly and WebGPU.
